VERDICT: FAIL

The evidence shows tests pass and no dependency changes, satisfying criterion (2). However, criterion (1) requires that the bug actually be fixed—and the evidence provided does not demonstrate this. The CI log shows 58 tests pass, but there is no evidence that any test specifically covers the rounding drift bug (no failing-then-passing test, no new test, no diff of the actual code fix). "All tests pass" only confirms the bug is fixed if a test would have caught it. Without the code diff or a regression test targeting the rounding drift, the claim that the bug is fixed is unverified.
